jobs_results.description:
Desde Sotec Consulting estamos buscando un consultor DevOps para importante empresa del sector bancario ubicada en Boadilla del Monte

FUNCIONES A DESARROLLAR:

Desarrollo y mejora de microservicios para extracción de datos y posterior envío a brokers (Kafka)
-Desarrollo de APIS consiguiendo una arquitectura orientada a eventos
-Desarrollo de cuadros de mando tácticos a partir de creación de acciones y workflows en Github.com (necesarios conocimientos de desarrollo con yalm y typesrcript) y Github apps
-Integración entre las diferentes herramientas que forman parte de la plataforma: Github.com, Nexus, Harbor, Sonarqube, Fortify, Kubernetes
-Conocimiento de los diferentes modelos de control de versiones o flujo de trabajo:

Gitflow, Gitops

CONOCIMIENTOS DESEABLES
·Agile methodologies (Scrum)
·API development and deployment knowledge
·Experiencia con Java/Spring, acceso a BBDD, conocimientos de Java, experiencia con Java/Spring, acceso a BBDD, conocimientos de Kafka
·Origenes de datos... deseados o PostgreSQL, Elastic
-Desarrollo orientado a eventos con Kafka o similar
-Conocimiento de desarrollo con APIs
·Conocimiento de herramientas de integración continua (preferiblemente Github)

CONOCIMIENTOS VALORABLES
·Conocimientos de transformaciones de datos en datalake
·Conocimientos de herramientas de analisis de datos, especialmente Power BI, Grafana

Ofrecemos:
- Proyecto estable con contrato indefinido.
- Jornada completa.
- Modalidad 100% REMOTO.
- Plan de formación continua.
- Retribución flexible.
- Salario competitivo, negociable en función de la experiencia.

jobs_results.description:
SQLI Group is a digital agency, with 30 years leading the implementation and management of digital devices for a reinvented user experience. We are over 2500 talents in more than 13 countries and 3 continents. We are a human touch company & key partner of the largest international companies with global projects.

We #Perceive #Challenge #Deliver #Inspire

Job Description

We are looking for an expert of Software Development Lifecycle to fulfil all tasks and duties as a Senior DevOps Release Engineer . He/she will review the whole DevOps set up for a global eCommerce platform application. This is within an international project for one of the top 3 food & beverage companies in the world.

What is this all about?

The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing the software release process, ensuring the quality of the software, and implementing DevOps practices to improve software development efficiency.
• He/she will assess the lifecycle of this eCommerce platform applications... identifying requirements, DevOps tools & platforms and automation gaps to ensure an agile & DevSecOps ways of working.
• This person will also coordinate all the teams working on the definition and automation of the desired solutions for eCommerce applications, ensuring that the high-level priorities set by the project/program manager are properly mapped to the day-to-day tasks, and following up on the quality of the deliverables.
• He/she will also participate in the adoption of the new software development lifecycle, finding the right balance for the introduction in an ongoing release cycle delivery for eCommerce applications.
• Monitor and report on system health and performance metrics, and proactively identify and resolve issues.
• Continuously improve the DevOps process through research and experimentation with new tools, technologies, and methodologies

Qualifications

Who are you?
• Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in software development, with at least 2 years in a DevOps or release role.
• Deep understanding about software development lifecycle, who can consolidate (and challenge) the needs of requestors, developers, testers, platform and system engineers, and support teams, identifying gaps and dependencies.
• Experience with continuous integration and continuous deployment tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or CircleCI.
• Sound knowledge of Jenkins, and Ansible. Experience with containerization and container orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
• Familiarity with cloud infrastructure platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

Additional Information

What do we offer?
• Permanent contract.
• Competitive salary.
• Flexible Remuneration (Meal vouchers, kinder garden, Public Transport/Mobility)
• Private health insurance (including dental care).
• Juno Journey Premium member platform with a lot of on-line learnings (certifications, courses, etc).
• Individual yearly training and certification budget.
• Onsite/Hybridpolicy work.
• Work Schedule Monday to Friday.
• Intensive working hours on Fridays and all week in July and August.
• Full salary coverage for sick leave.
• Relocation package.

Data protection notice

SQLI Group ensures that applicants' personal data is processed as required by the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Ley de Protección de Datos 3/2018 of the Spanish Kingdom . Personal data is processed for the purpose of carrying out the hiring process and joining to our talent community. You can exercise your rights in terms of General Data Protection and digital guarantees through dataprotection.spain@sqli.com

Company Description

At T-Systems, you will find groundbreaking projects that contribute to social and ecological well-being. We want to welcome new talents like you, who bring fresh ideas, different perspectives, embrace challenges, and are committed to continuous learning in order to grow and make an impact on society... all in a fun way!

It doesn't matter when or where you work. It's about doing meaningful work that advances society. For this reason, we will do everything possible to ensure that you have all the development opportunities by providing a support network, excellent technology, a new work environment, and the freedom to work autonomously. We support you in growing both personally and professionally so that you can make a notable impact on society.

T-Systems is a team of around 28,000 employees worldwide, making us one of the leading global providers of end-to-end integrated solutions. We develop hybrid cloud solutions, artificial intelligence, and drive the digital... transformation of companies, industries, the public sector, and ultimately, society as a whole.

Job Description

The digital society wouldn’t be possible without us. Our employees provide our customers with the best network, with a reliable and secure infrastructure. The basis for tomorrow's innovations. We have the best prospects for the digital future. For you right from the start.

The company Deutsche Telekom Technik GmbH is a 100 percent subsidiary of Telekom Deutschland GmbH and provides the nationwide technical infrastructure of the group. Around 19,000 employees at DT Technik plan, design, build and operate the facilities and systems of the technical infrastructure nationwide on behalf of Telekom Deutschland GmbH. The company implements network projects, operates the network technology and, if necessary, takes over the maintenance of the technical infrastructure.

The Tribe Voice & Messaging is responsible for the design, development, planning, validation and operation of all voice and messaging platforms in DT Technik's fixed and mobile network over their entire lifecycle. We provide innovative, reliable state-of-the-art services to our cellular- and landline-based customers.

The scope of a current program is to bring voice & messaging applications into the cloud. We’ll change the today’s model of separated fixed and mobile systems and merge them. That’s why we want you on our team.

Activity description and concrete tasks:
• You will support project teams in the development, quality assurance and planning as well as implementation of product releases.
• You will design further automations of services, processes and/or operating models, you will carry out performance analyses and tunings as well as error analysis and fixes
• You will support the automation of deployments in all environments
• You will provide a project-specific infrastructure and tool suite for integration and delivery, and administer these
• You manage projects

Qualifications

You are characterized by the following knowledge and skills:
• Expert knowledge in agile development methods (like Kanban, Scrum, etc.)
• In-depth knowledge of DevOps technologies and tools (e.g. Gitlab, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Flux, Test Automation using Python/ behave or Ruby/Cucumber, Zabbix)
• Detailed knowledge of the market, technology and competitive environment in the information technology and telecommunications industry, including digital transformation

Nice to have skills:
• Understanding German would be helpful (optional)
• Basic IMS knowledge with relevant communication protocols (e.g. SIP and RTP) and Telecommunications Industry experience preferred
• Experience in IT project management

Tools & Platforms:

GitLab, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Flux, Test Automation using Python/ behave or Ruby/Cucumber, Zabbix

Additional Information

What do we offer you?

- International, positive, dynamic, and motivated work environment.

- Hybrid work model (telework/face-to-face).

- Flexible schedule.

- Continuous training.

- Flexible Compensation Plan.

- Life and accident insurance.

- More than 25 working days of vacation per year.

And many more advantages of being part of T-Systems!

If you are looking for a new challenge, do not hesitate to send us your CV! Please send CV in English. Join our team!

Senior DevOps Engineering - Santander Digital Services

Country: Spain

SANTANDER DIGITAL SERVICES is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer based in one of our Hubs in Boadilla del Monte ,Cantabria and Málaga.

WHY YOU SHOULD CONSIDER THIS OPPORTUNITY

At Santander (www.santander.com) we are key players in the transformation of the financial sector. Do you want to join us?

Santander Digital Services (SDS) is the team of technology and operations at Santander. We are convinced of the importance of technology that is aligned with the requirements of the business and that out work not only brings value to users, people and communities but also fosters individual creativity. Our team of over 7,000 people in 8 countries (Spain, Portugal, Poland, UK, USA, Mexico, Chile and Brazil) develops and/or implements financial solutions across a broad spectrum of technologies (including Blockchain, Big Data and Angular among others) on all kinds of on-premises and cloud-based platforms.

UK Tower is... the Santander UK Nearshoring strategy vehicle in Santander Digital Services located in Spain, to provide technology workforce and services directly to Santander UK that will work together and for UK Technology teams.

Santander is proud of being an organization where there are equal opportunities regardless of gender identity, culture and disability. Our mission is to contribute to help more people and business prosper. We embrace a strong risk culture and all of our professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will have the opportunity to lead and coordinate software projects in a highly dynamic and inventive environment.

We value delivering high-quality products that meet the needs of our customers. To this end, we are seeking candidates who will oversee the entire software development lifecycle, from planning to deployment and beyond.

We need someone like you to help us in different fronts:
• Identifying, planning, and implementing solutions to improve the reliability, resilience and efficiency of the public cloud environment by developing innovative and automated processes.
• Providing high level advice on technical solutions and priorities for the infrastructure function.
• Focusing on day-to-day operations, delivery of new services and solutions and capacity planning to ensure IT infrastructure meets the current and future requirements of the organization.
• Ensuring the provision of full-service delivery, undertaking, and supporting structure planning to ensure sufficient system capacity is made available.
• Resolving complex technical issues and providing senior technical solutions in response to queries from across the business as well as from within IT.
• Analyzing technical specifications of systems infrastructure and communication platforms, to meet the needs of San UK
• Train the development team on design patterns and performance tuning strategies. Be passionate about making nitty gritty, hands-on improvements.
• Lead and mentor a team of engineers to further their technical prowess. You succeed when your team does!

EXPERIENCE
• +5 years of related experience.

EDUCATION
• University degree in technology, preferably in computer science.

SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE
• Knowledge of DevOps tooling and methodologies including code repositories, bug tracking tools, Confluence, JIRA etc.
• Knowledge of IT incident management: ability to investigate, troubleshoot, recover and prevent the recurrence of incidents that interfere with the normal delivery of IT services.
• Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
• Skills and experience in Change Control/Incident management of leading the recovery of infrastructure outages.
• A strong understanding of API orchestration, combined with languages such as Python to implement automated solutions and interactions between core management services such as Dynatrace, AWS, ServiceNow etc.
• Experience in software development and/or system administration, with a focus on reliability, availability, and scalability.
• Strong focus on design and delivery, taking complex problems and delivering well documented and tested solutions to those problems.

OTHER INFORMATION
• English at least C1
• Availability to travel if needed.

If you want to know more about us, visit our website https://www.betechwithsantander.com/en/home

jobs_results.description:
What you can expect

- Our Manufacturing Data Integration team offers solutions for connecting devices, machines and systems from BASF`s production environment to the digital world. Data connectivity is the essential foundation for every digital application - we deliver manufacturing data with innovative and high available integration technology to enable BASF´s digital applications

Your main responsibilities:

- You will work as a developer in our DevOps team on global solutions for the integration of process data from the field level to the cloud
- You will further develop the existing and future solution landscape based on the needs of our production, your tasks will cover the entire spectrum: requirements analysis, specification and implementation of the solution, as well as system and integration tests, up to commissioning, support and quality assurance
- The focus of your work is the continuous development of a sustainable, scalable and flexible infrastructure for data... integration. You will use inhouse-developed software solutions as well as products from external suppliers to design data integration between complex, heterogeneous and proprietary system landscapes
- You transfer the methodological core of agile software development to your daily work
- You support the team to improve the software development and guide it professionally by contributing your experience and communicating concepts
- You participate in active market observation, technology and trend scouting in the field of data integration, software engineering and design patterns, Big Data stream processing and IoT

Our main requirements:

- Successfully completed degree in computer science or equivalent, and at least 2 years of software development experience, preferably in .NET, python and LUA
- In-depth knowledge and experience with real-time data acquisition, Web development, (dashboarding, web interfaces,¡) and API handling (e.g. REST), data integration, machine-to-machine communication, message brokers and streaming interfaces, preferably from a production environment
- Knowledge of hybrid cloud architectures, e.g., using Azure services, such as Event Hub, IoT Hub, API Gateway, as well as edge computing with containerbased applications
- Knowledge and experience with modern programming environments and frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, event-driven, service-oriented software architectures, and agile development approaches to integrate products from external vendors and to develop own solutions where no external, suitable products exist.
- Knowledge and experience in dealing with external suppliers to drive the development of the deployed external products
- Knowledge of database (SQL, MongoDB), Big Data, network topologies and IoT technologies
- Fluent in English, German knowledge is a plus, strong teamwork and communication skills, confident demeanor and initiative, as well as analytical thinking skills and a structured way of working
- You enjoy working in a motivated team of technology experts, driving innovative solutions, promoting mutual exchange, a good team atmosphere and actively contributing to achieve common goals

Nice to have:

- Knowledge of the OT domain (PLC, DCS, SCADA, process industry automation systems in general)

What´s in it for you:

- A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority.
- Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life.
- Learning and development opportunities
- 28 holiday days per year
- A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment
- Being part of an international team and work in global projects
- Relocation assistance to Madrid provided

Posición: DevOps Engineer (Azure)
Location: Sanz

At Pay Retailers, we are committed to providing cutting-edge solutions that empower businesses to succeed in Latin America. Our collaborative and inclusive work environment encourages creativity and growth, where every employee's contribution is valued. Get ready to embark on an exciting journey with us, as we strive to make a meaningful impact on the world of payments.

Our Tech team is looking for aDevOps Engineer with experience in Azurefor our new office in Sofia. This is a key player rolefor establishing and growing the product development teams in Bulgaria.

Experience and Qualifications:
• Develop & Optimize:

Craft and scale cloud-native solutions in Azure. Your mission is to make our cloud setup smarter, faster, and more efficient.
• Team Up:
Join forces with application teams on cloud projects. Enhance our CI/CD pipelines for smoother, quicker deployments.
• Explore & Implement:

Dive into cloud engineering, focusing on... innovative infrastructure solutions that tackle complex challenges.
• Brings 3+ years of experience with MS Azure and a total of 5+ years in the Dev Ops arena to the table.

AWS gurus willing and able to learn fast are also welcome.
• Understands containerization concepts and is eager to apply this knowledge in a practical setting.
• Has a grasp of cloud security, networking, and is familiar with web apps, integration scenarios and databases (Postgres, No

SQL).
• Has profound knowledge in Azure cloud network security and deeply understands the concepts of private endpoints, private DNS and traffic routing.
• Is comfortable navigating Git Ops and CI/CD tools, with a knack for scripting (Bash, Python) and Bitbucket pipelining.
• Knows the ins and outs of APIM and authentication flows, including authentication mechanisms for PaaS, JWT tokens and B2C model, ensuring our applications are both secure and scalable.
• Expertise in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and JSON driven terraform infrastructure.
• Be at the forefront of our cloud journey in Sofia, directly shaping our infrastructure and deployment strategies.
• Enjoy a role that blends strategic planning with hands-on execution in a dynamic, agile environment.
• Seize opportunities for professional growth in a setting that values innovation and practical problem-solving.

What we offer:
• Competitive salary
• Opportunities to grow within a company in hypergrowth stage
• Additional days of holidays
• Free language classes
• Free Multisport card
• Possibility of working from home up to 4 days per week during the first months
